name: Vintage Story
description: Install a Vintage Story dedicated server at an exact stable or release-candidate version from the official source, then manage its configuration and mods.
known_limitations: Requires the .NET runtime matching the server version (.NET 8 for 1.21, .NET 10 for 1.22); GameNode does not install it.
Only versions 1.21.0 and newer are offered.
The configuration file is created by the server on first start, so the Configuration tab becomes available after the first start.
World seed, play style and other nested world settings are not managed here; use the in-game or console tools.
Mods are .zip archives in data/Mods added by upload; loose .dll/.cs mods are not managed.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: Exact Vintage Story server version, for example 1.22.7 or 1.22.0-rc.10

variables.name: Server port
variables.description: Port players connect to (TCP and UDP)

config_files.description: Server configuration created by the server on first start; managed by the GameNode adapter.

requirements.description: A matching .NET runtime must be installed and reachable through DOTNET_ROOT or PATH.
Installation downloads only from the official Vintage Story servers and verifies the published checksum; mods are added by upload, never from a URL.

help.summary: GameNode downloads the selected server archive, verifies its checksum, extracts it safely, and launches dotnet directly with structured arguments.
notes: Mods are managed on the server Mods tab.
Start the server once so it creates data/serverconfig.json, then use the Configuration tab.

prerequisites: .NET runtime matching the server version (DOTNET_ROOT or PATH)
Network access to the official Vintage Story download servers
